Bug_Title: "toString()" and "clone()" methods should not return null
Bug_Explanation: The toString() method returns null when the object is empty, violating the implicit contract that it should always return a String.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBugWithEmptyObject' creates an empty BuggyToString object and then calls the showBug() method with true as the argument. The showBug() method internally calls the toString() method of the BuggyToString object, which returns null when the object is empty. This violates the implicit contract of the toString() method and triggers the bug.
